API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingRegion Info Resource Get Region By Src IP Address
Region Info Resource Get Region By Src IP Address
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/region/byIPAddress/:ip

Retrieves information about the geo-location of the specified IP address, including the city, state, and country of location, geographical ID of the city and state, postal code, etc.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ip
string
REQUIRED

The IP address for which you want to retrieve the geo-location and other geographical data.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
cityGeoId
int32

The geographical ID of the city

stateGeoId
int32

The geographical ID of the state

latitude
double

The latitude coordinate of the city

longitude
double

The longitude coordinate of the city

cityName
string

The name of the city

stateName
string

The name of the state, province, or territory of a country

countryName
string

The name of the country

countryCode
string

The ISO standard two-letter country code

postalCode
string

The postal code

continentCode
string

The ISO standard two-letter continent code
